scope: append-only evidence-based period x theme x geography delta, NOT a replacement for 2112-cell provisional matrix
method: Read explanatory candidates and test whether a coherent visitor explanation has independently located material and recognizable physical features. Single-page institutional summaries alone are developing or sparse, never substantial.
